pokedexEntries.dp: It freezes foes with an icy breath nearly -60 degrees F. What seems to be its body is actually hollow.

pokedexEntries.pt: It freezes prey by blowing its -58 degrees F breath. It is said to then secretly display its prey.

pokedexEntries.hg: Legends in snowy regions say that a woman who was lost on an icy mountain was reborn as FROSLASS.

pokedexEntries.ss: Legends in snowy regions say that a woman who was lost on an icy mountain was reborn as FROSLASS

pokedexEntries.bw: It freezes prey by blowing its -58 degrees F breath. It is said to then secretly display its prey.

pokedexEntries.b2w2: It freezes prey by blowing its -58 degrees F breath. It is said to then secretly display its prey.

pokedexEntries.x: It freezes foes with an icy breath nearly -60 degrees Fahrenheit. What seems to be its body is actually hollow.

pokedexEntries.or: It freezes foes with an icy breath nearly -60 degrees Fahrenheit. What seems to be its body is actually hollow.

pokedexEntries.y: Legends in snowy regions say that a woman who was lost on an icy mountain was reborn as Froslass.

pokedexEntries.as: Legends in snowy regions say that a woman who was lost on an icy mountain was reborn as Froslass.

pokedexEntries.su: When it finds humans or Pokémon it likes, it freezes them and takes them to its chilly den, where they become decorations.

pokedexEntries.mo: The soul of a woman lost on a snowy mountain possessed an icicle, becoming this Pokémon. The food it most relishes is the souls of men.

pokedexEntries.us: It freezes hikers who have come to climb snowy mountains and carries them back to its home. It only goes after men it thinks are handsome.

pokedexEntries.um: It’s said that on nights of terrible blizzards, it comes down to human settlements. If you hear it knocking at your door, do not open it!

pokedexEntries.sw: After a woman met her end on a snowy mountain, her regrets lingered on. From them, this Pokémon was born. Its favorite food is frozen souls.

pokedexEntries.sh: It spits out cold air of nearly −60 degrees Fahrenheit to freeze its quarry. It brings frozen prey back to its lair and neatly lines them up.

pokedexEntries.bdsp: It freezes foes with an icy breath that is nearly −60 degrees Fahrenheit. What seems to be its body is actually hollow.

pokedexEntries.la: A Pokémon inhabited by the soul of a woman who died bearing a grudge in the snowy mountains. Legends of Froslass placing deathly curses on misbehaving men send shivers down my spine.

pokedexEntries.sc: When it finds humans or Pokémon it likes, it freezes them and takes them to its chilly den, where they become decorations.

pokedexEntries.vi: It freezes prey by blowing its −58 degree Fahrenheit breath. It is said to then secretly display its prey.

pokedexEntries.za: It freezes foes with an icy breath that is nearly −60 degrees Fahrenheit. What seems to be its body is actually hollow.
